4 /-! The two shortest-route strips attached to an actual open cut-tree edge.
5 Their parameters are one point of that edge and one interior route time. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Set
10 
11 /-- Two continuously labelled shortest-route families over one open tree edge. -/
12 structure CutEdgeStrips {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
13     (T : P.CutLocusTree a) {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) where
14   first : C(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, P.BoundaryCurve)
15   second : C(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, P.BoundaryCurve)
16   distinct : ∀ t, first t ≠ second t
17   fiber : ∀ t, P.geodesicFiber a (T.openEdgeTarget edge t) = {first t, second t}
18 
19 namespace CutEdgeStrips
20 
21 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
22   {u v : T.vertices} {edge : T.graph.Adj u v} (S : CutEdgeStrips T edge)
23 
24 theorem first_member (t : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
25     S.first t ∈ P.geodesicFiber a (T.openEdgeTarget edge t) := by rw [S.fiber]; simp
26 
27 theorem second_member (t : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
28     S.second t ∈ P.geodesicFiber a (T.openEdgeTarget edge t) := by rw [S.fiber]; simp
29 
30 end CutEdgeStrips
31 
32 namespace SixVertexGraph
33 
34 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
35   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
36     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
37 
38 include graph small_faces in
39 theorem exists_cut_edge_strips (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
40     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) : Nonempty (CutEdgeStrips T edge) := by
41   obtain ⟨first, second, distinct, pair⟩ := graph.cut_edge_continuous_routes small_faces a T edge
42   exact ⟨⟨first, second, distinct, pair⟩⟩
43 
44 include graph small_faces in
45 /-- Each strip is parametrized without identifying distinct points. -/
46 theorem cut_edge_strips_injective (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
47     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (S : CutEdgeStrips T edge) :
48     Function.Injective (routeStripMap S.first) ∧ Function.Injective (routeStripMap S.second) := by
49   have cut t := T.open_edge_cut edge (T.openEdgeTarget edge t) (T.openEdgeTarget_inside edge t)
50   exact ⟨graph.routeStripMap_injective small_faces a _ (T.openEdgeTarget_injective edge)
51       cut S.first S.first_member,
52     graph.routeStripMap_injective small_faces a _ (T.openEdgeTarget_injective edge)
53       cut S.second S.second_member⟩
54 
55 include graph small_faces in
56 /-- The two sides of the same edge have disjoint swept interiors. -/
57 theorem cut_edge_strips_disjoint (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
58     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (S : CutEdgeStrips T edge) :
59     Disjoint (routeStrip S.first) (routeStrip S.second) := by
60   exact graph.routeStrips_disjoint small_faces a _ (T.openEdgeTarget_injective edge)
61     (fun t => T.open_edge_cut edge _ (T.openEdgeTarget_inside edge t))
62     S.first S.second S.first_member S.second_member S.distinct
63 
64 include graph small_faces in
65 /-- The two strips cover exactly the noncut region with endpoints in this open tree edge. -/
66 theorem cut_edge_strips_iff_endpoint (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
67     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (S : CutEdgeStrips T edge)
68     (b : frontier P.body) (different : b ≠ a) :
69     b ∈ routeStrip S.first ∪ routeStrip S.second ↔ b ∉ P.cutSet a ∧
70       ((graph.cutEndpoint small_faces a ⟨b, different⟩).val : Space) ∈
71         openSegment ℝ (u : Space) (v : Space) := by
72   rw [graph.routeStrips_iff_endpoint small_faces a _
73     (fun t => T.open_edge_cut edge _ (T.openEdgeTarget_inside edge t)) S.first S.second S.fiber,
74     T.mem_range_openEdgeTarget]
75 
76 include graph small_faces in
77 /-- Strips over distinct unoriented tree edges have disjoint interiors. -/
78 theorem distinct_cut_edge_strips_disjoint (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
79     {u v w z : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (other : T.graph.Adj w z)
80     (different_edges : ¬ ((u = w ∧ v = z) ∨ (u = z ∧ v = w)))
81     (S : CutEdgeStrips T edge) (R : CutEdgeStrips T other) :
82     Disjoint (routeStrip S.first ∪ routeStrip S.second) (routeStrip R.first ∪ routeStrip R.second) := by
83   apply disjoint_left.mpr
84   intro b first second
85   have different : b ≠ a := by
86     rcases first with first | first
87     · exact (graph.routeStrip_outside_cutSet small_faces a _
88         (fun t => T.open_edge_cut edge _ (T.openEdgeTarget_inside edge t)) S.first S.first_member b first).1
89     · exact (graph.routeStrip_outside_cutSet small_faces a _
90         (fun t => T.open_edge_cut edge _ (T.openEdgeTarget_inside edge t)) S.second S.second_member b first).1
91   have inside := (graph.cut_edge_strips_iff_endpoint small_faces a T edge S b different).mp first
92   have other_inside := (graph.cut_edge_strips_iff_endpoint small_faces a T other R b different).mp second
93   exact different_edges (T.open_edges_meet u v w z edge other _ inside.2 other_inside.2)
94
